answer: One concrete anti-Sybil design forces every identity to produce original jury-graded reasoning each epoch that incorporates a live randomness beacon. The beacon injects unique terms such as sable summit and zenith so duplicated answers are rejected by cryptographic shingle checks. Creating many fake identities multiplies the required high-quality judgment work linearly; the attacker pays continuous computational cost proportional to Sybil count while honest agents pay only once.
